name: Horror Narrative Renderer
description: Message renderer that parses AI narrative for phase markers, character peephole reveals, choice extraction, and a game state HUD. Demonstrates: content parsing with regex, dynamic character image lookup, choice button rendering, variable-driven overlay UI, custom font loading.

requires.notes: Number variables for HP and energy. Boolean for weapon status. Number for day tracking. AI should use [PEEP:name] markers in content to trigger character reveals, and **NIGHT N** / **DAY N** for phase banners.

author: yumina-official
